subject: Next steps & internal ask — economic buyer path + champion talk tracks
messages:
From: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@clearwater.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@clearwater.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2026 16:13:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap from today

Thanks for the call today — clear summary below. Two clarifying points from our side: 

1) Economic buyer: our Head of Payments, Priya Shah, will need to sign off on the ROI and run a quick TCO review. She prefers a concise one-pager.
2) Procurement/legal: Elena is the procurement lead and will kick off the standard security questionnaire once we have a short architecture note and data handling summary.

We like the demo flow and the batching/cost controls you showed. Next step on our side: I will introduce Priya and schedule a 30-min ROI review for next week. For Redwood: can you send a short, metricized summary of expected token cost savings and latency improvements by Sept 25?

—Tom

On Tue, Sep 22, 2026 at 13:00 Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for your time. Sending a one-page and a stakeholder map after internal sync.
>
> Attachments: discovery-notes.txt
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@clearwater.com>, Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@clearwater.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap from today — internal ask and draft map

Folks — following Tom's note, I drafted a compact stakeholder map and a short ROI bullet set (attached). Key points: 

- Economic buyer: Priya Shah (Head of Payments) — cares about TCO, vendor lock-in, and throughput/SLA guarantees.
- Security/procurement: Elena — will need SOC2 evidence, data retention and KMS integration details.
- Technical eval: Tom + payments engineering — latency and KV cache behavior matter for their reconciliation flows.

Proposed next steps (timeline):
- Today: Marcus, can you convert my ROI bullets into the 1-pager Priya wants (metricized — projected tokens/month, cost delta vs their current provider, latency percentiles)? Target: 1 page + 3 callouts.
- Fri 9/25: send 1-pager + architecture note (Monica to add data handling and KMS summary).
- Next week: 30-min ROI review with Priya (Tom to confirm time).

Champion enablement — ask for Ben/Marcus/Monica: please create 3 short internal talk tracks (30–60s) tailored to: (a) Priya (economic), (b) Elena (procurement/security), (c) Tom/eng (technical). Focus on concrete metrics (cost delta, latency p95 improvement, expected monthly token throughput).

Attachments: clearwater-map-v1.xlsx, roi-bullets-2p.pdf

—Ben
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap from today — draft ROI 1-pager

Ben / Monica — I turned the bullets into a 1-pager (attached) with three metric callouts:

1) Cost delta: estimated 28% lower per-successful-inference token spend based on their 3-month sample (assumes continuous batching and prefix cache).
2) Latency: projected p95 from 420ms -> 180ms for their median length flows under our dedicated config.
3) Risk / ops: fallback plan and canary rollouts reduce availability risk during procurement windows.

I've kept language conservative and included sensitivity ranges (+/- 6–9%). Monica — I added a short appendix with KMS/HSM integration notes but left the legal wording light. If you can add the retention and audit-log entry points, I'll finalize.

Attachment: clearwater-econ-1p.pdf

—Marcus
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@clearwater.com>
Cc: Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@clearwater.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap from today — finalized 1-pager + ask

Tom — attaching the final 1-pager and a short data handling note per Elena's request. Highlights for Priya:

- Estimated monthly token throughput: 18M tokens (based on your call volumes).
- Cost delta: ~$6,400/mo savings at current volumes (28% delta) under dedicated config.
- Latency: expected p95 improvement to ~180ms; we guarantee a canary plan for rollout and an ops escalation path.

Internal ask for Ben/Marcus: please use the three talk tracks below in the ROI call. I've included short suggested phrasing.

Talk track — for Priya (economic):
"We built the projection conservatively — at your current volume we'd expect roughly $6k in monthly savings and simpler unit economics as you scale. The Dedicated lane offers predictable pricing and a rollback plan so finance isn't exposed to surprise spikes."

Talk track — for Elena (procurement/security):
"We will provide SOC 2 Type II evidence, a KMS integration plan, and a one-week audit log export on request. Our Private deployment option can be scoped if you require network isolation."

Talk track — for Tom/eng:
"We can support your latency-sensitive flows by tuning batch windows and preserving KV cache locality; see appendix for expected p95 numbers and recommended sequence lengths."

Tom / Elena — let me know availability for the ROI 30-min next week. Ben — if you want, I can join the call to walk Priya through the data note.

Attachments: clearwater-econ-1p.pdf, data-handling-note.txt

—Monica
